limitations: Same-browser frozen-source pixel comparisons; not cross-device goldens.
Static observer poses are not scored attempts or demonstration commands.
No FPS, sustained performance, physical-device or human art acceptance claim.
Disposal asserts registered ownership is empty, not zero driver memory; Three.js may retain internal lookup allocations until context release.
Sightline rays compare visible opaque mesh triangles; they do not resolve alpha-texture holes or certify human readability of rendered objective cues.
No additional unit-test coverage. Production scene observation restores the original method immediately after renderer creation.
